page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.16xlarge is a compute-optimized arm64 instance powered by a custom 64-core Alibaba Yitian YiTian710 processor running at 2.75 GHz with dedicated CPU allocation. The server features 64 physical cores without hyperthreading, equipped with 64 KB L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB L2 cache per core, and 64 MB of shared L3 cache. It incorporates 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, does not include local ephemeral storage, and lacks dedicated GPU accelerators.

Performance testing demonstrates strong parallel compute capabilities and high memory subsystem responsiveness. In multi-threaded workloads, the Yitian710 architecture delivers strong results in stress-ng multi-core tests and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, while achieving top-tier performance in the PassMark memory benchmark. Cached memory reads reach 6476.63 GB/sec. Microbenchmarks show solid database and key-value store efficiency, achieving 94.6 million Redis SET operations per second and strong PassMark database operation scores. Conversely, single-core processing—including stress-ng single-core tests and gzip compression—falls within average ranges, reflecting an architecture designed for core density rather than peak single-thread execution speed. Small model LLM inference and web serving throughput also remain in the middle tier.

The ecs.c8y.16xlarge offers high core density and efficient resource utilization for multi-threaded applications, benefiting workloads that scale horizontally across physical ARM cores. The absence of local disk storage means persistent storage must be attached over the network, which may introduce latency considerations for I/O-intensive storage applications. The lower memory-to-vCPU ratio restricts suitability for large in-memory databases requiring high RAM per core. This instance type is best suited for compute-bound parallel tasks, microservices backends, high-concurrency Redis caching layers, web application tiers, and multi-threaded data transformation jobs.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance equipped with a 64-core ARM-based Alibaba Yitian YiTian710 processor running at 2.75 GHz, paired with 128.0 GB of memory and 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Built on 64 dedicated physical cores without hyperthreading, it features 64 MB of shared L3 cache. Benchmark evaluations highlight strong multi-core execution and high memory throughput, evidenced by top-tier PassMark memory scores and strong results in multi-threaded decompression, physics simulations, and Redis SET throughput reaching 94.6 million operations per second. However, single-core benchmarks and LLM prompt processing remain in the average performance tier. With no local storage attached, disk operations rely on cloud network storage. The 1:2 memory-to-core ratio provides favorable compute density for high-concurrency workloads, making it well suited for web microservices, multi-threaded CI/CD builds, redis caching tiers, and parallel data transformation pipelines.
